The '''Incident on Bal'demnic''' was a mission undertaken by [[Bith/Legends|Bith]] [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Darth Tenebrous/Legends|Darth Tenebrous]], and his apprentice, the [[Muun/Legends|Muun]] [[Darth Plagueis/Legends|Darth Plagueis]], to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Bal'demnic/Legends|Bal'demnic]] in [[67 BBY/Legends|67 BBY]].

==Prelude==
In 67 BBY, [[Subtext Mining]] provided [[Darth Tenebrous/Legends|Darth Tenebrous]] with secret intelligence revealing large deposits of [[Cortosis/Legends|cortosis ore]] within the [[Bal'demnic/Legends|planet's crust]]. Tenebrous acted on the new information personally, traveling to Bal'demnic with his apprentice, [[Darth Plagueis/Legends|Darth Plagueis]]. Tenebrous believed by having two [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lords]] mining cortosis at the very apex of the [[Rule of Two/Legends|Rule of Two]] era it would "Close the Circle"&mdash;a Circle that had begun with [[Darth Bane/Legends|Darth Bane]] starting on the path [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|towards darkness]] in the Apatros cortosis mines a millennium earlier.<ref name="Plagueis" />

==The incident==
In a crystalline cave, Tenebrous commanded [[M-2 mining probe droid|Subtext's M-2 mining probe droid]] to verify the secret mining survey team's claims. During the process, the M-2 unit ceased taking orders from the Sith Lord, and proceeded to drill in the direction of a highly combustible pocket of [[lethane]] gas. Having sensed great danger, Tenebrous fled the cave with his [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]]. Before they were able to reach the surface, the Sith Lords were overcome by the large explosion caused by the M-2 unit's breach of the lethane pocket. The surrounding cavern ceiling collapsed, and both Master and Apprentice used [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to prevent large slabs of rock that were falling to crush them and [[Darth Tenebrous's personal starship|their ship]].<ref name="Plagueis" />

With Tenebrous distracted, Plagueis realized that the fear his Master had sensed earlier was his own [[Death/Legends|death]]&mdash;at his apprentice's hands. Plagueis betrayed his master by using the Force to send the levitated slabs crashing down on Tenebrous, crushing him almost to death, and damaging his ship. After a brief exchange of words, in which Plagueis said the Rule of Two would end with them, Plagueis snapped his Master's neck, slowly killing him, when the Bith expressed disappointment in Plagueis for stranding himself on a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] where he was required to wear an [[Environment suit/Legends|enviro-suit]]. Plagueis then used the Force to observe Tenebrous' [[Midi-chlorian/Legends|midi-chlorians]] slowly die as he died.<ref name="Plagueis" />

==Aftermath==
Over a long sleepless night, Plagueis traveled on foot utilizing a [[Force speed/Legends|Force speed]] technique to cover hundreds of kilometers to [[Kon'meas Spaceport]]. There he stowed aboard the ''[[Woebegone]]'', whose crew he killed whilst in transit, and took the ship to [[Muunilinst/Legends|Muunilinst]].<ref name="Plagueis" />
